p: gathered themselves to David unto Hebron: This was after the death of Ishbosheth Saul's son, when David had reigned over Judah seven years and six months in Hebron, 2Sa 5:5.
chief of the captains: Meaning, the most excellent and best esteemed for his valiantry: some read, the chief of the princes.
and delivered it: This act refers to Shammah, 2Sa 23:11, who it seems was the chiefest of these.
thirty captains went down to the: That is, Eleazar and his two companions.
blood of these men that have: That is, this water, for which they risked their lives.
first three: Meaning, those three who brought the water to David.
Shammoth the Harorite: Called also Shammah, 2Sa 23:25.
Sibbecai the Hushathite: He is also called Mebunnai, 2Sa 23:27.
